test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

His struggles were becoming / more and more frenzier,/ with a wild look creeping into his blue eyes.

options.text: a wild look creeping into his blue eyes.

solution:
The correct answer is **"more and more frenzied."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence the error is in the second part (more and more frenzier,) of the sentence.
